body.name: muH
body.def: \(\mu_H(\zeta)=(|R|,|\Sigma|,|\mathcal L|,|\mathcal F|,|\mathcal R|)\), ordered lexicographically after compiler refresh. A selector transition reduces \(|\Sigma|\); a nonancestor elimination or fixing transition reduces \(|R|\); a district split consumes its sole current \(\ell\)-token before any newly exposed fixing work; and a residual transition consumes the sole residual token and halts.
